questions.question: The HCF of three numbers 98, 175 and 210 will be:
questions.solution:
Given:

The numbers are 98, 175, and 210.

Concept:

HCF: Product of the smallest power of each common prime factor in the numbers.

Calculation:

98 = 2 × 7²

175 = 52 × 7

210 = 2 × 3 × 5 × 7

So, HCF = 7

∴ The required answer is 7.

questions.question: If two circles of radii 18 cm and 8 cm touch externally, then the length of a direct common tangent is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two circles of radii 18 cm and 8 cm touch externally

**Concept used:**

If two circles of radius R1 and R2 are touched externally then their direct common tangent = 2√(R1 and R2)

**Calculation:**

R1 = 18 cm

R2 = 8 cm

So, Direct common tangent = 2√(18 × 8)

⇒ 2√144

⇒ 2 × 12

⇒ 24 cm

∴ The length of the direct common tangent is 24 cm.

questions.question: Raghav purchased a shirt at Rs. 1,500 and marked up the price of the shirt by 40%. What is the discount percentage he has to offer in order to get a profit of Rs. 75?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume Cost Price (CP) = 100%, then Marked Price (MP) = 100% + 40% = 140%.

Profit % on CP = (75 ÷ 1500) × 100 = 5% ⇒ Selling Price (SP) = 105%.

Discount is given on MP, so Discount = MP − SP = 140% − 105% = 35%.

Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100 = (35 ÷ 140) × 100 = 25%.

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹1500

Markup = 40%

Profit = ₹75

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price (MP) = CP × (1 + Markup% ÷ 100)

Selling Price (SP) = CP + Profit

Discount % = ((MP − SP) ÷ MP) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/309c39235d836e7c5efc978bf9e79cd11cf0f03a92a6e8631a73a44e9f1ebd71.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ MP = 1500 × (1 + 40 ÷ 100) = 1500 × 1.4 = ₹2100

⇒ SP = 1500 + 75 = ₹1575

⇒ Discount = MP − SP = 2100 − 1575 = ₹525

⇒ Discount % = (525 ÷ 2100) × 100 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price (MP) & Discount

MP is the price printed or tagged on an article. Discounts are always calculated on the MP unless stated otherwise. The formula is: SP = MP − Discount.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of d₁% and d₂% are given on an article, the equivalent single discount given is (d₁ + d₂ − (d₁ × d₂) ÷ 100)%.

Direct CP to MP Ratio

The direct ratio between Cost Price and Marked Price can be quickly written as CP ÷ MP = (100 − Discount%) ÷ (100 + Profit%).

questions.question: If the seven-digit number 52A6B7C is divisible by 33, and A, B, C are primes, then the maximum value of 2A + 3B + C is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The seven-digit number 52A6B7C is divisible by 33

**Concept used:**

If the difference of the sum of alternative digits of a number is divisible by 11, then that number is divisible by 11 completely.

If the sum of digits of a number is a multiple of 3, the number will be completely divisible by 3.

**Calculation:**

5 + 2 + A + 6 + B + 7 + C = 20 + A + B + C

Possible values of (A + B + C) = 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19, 22, 25

Again,

5 + A + B + C - 2 - 6 - 7 = 0 or Multiple of 11

⇒ 5 + A + B + C - 15 = 0 or Multiple of 11

From the above possible values, for (A + B + C) = 10 we get 0

So, A + B + C = 10

Now,

If A = 5, B = 3, C = 2

2A + 3B + C = 10 + 9 + 2

⇒ 21

If A = 3, B = 5, C = 2

2A + 3B + C = 6 + 15 + 2

⇒ 23

If A = 3, B = 2, C = 5

2A + 3B + C = 6 + 6 + 2

⇒ 17

If A = 2, B = 5, C = 3

2A + 3B + C = 4 + 15 + 3

⇒ 22

So, The maximum value of 2A + 3B + C is 23.

**∴ The required answer is 23.**

questions.question: A watch is sold at a profit of 25%. Had it been sold for Rs. 120 less then, there would have been a loss of 15%. What is the cost price in rupees?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A watch is sold at a profit of 25%. Had it been sold for Rs. 120 less then, there would have been a loss of 15%.

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price be 100a

According to the question,

100a × 125% - 120 = 100a × 85%

⇒ 125a - 120 = 85a

⇒ 40a = 120

⇒ a = 3

So, cost price = 100 × 3 = Rs. 300

⇒ Rs. 300

**∴ The cost price in rupees is 300.**

questions.question: If the side of an equilateral triangle is 16 cm, then what is its area?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The side of the equilateral triangle is 16 cm.

**Concept used:**

Area of equilateral triangle = √3/4 × a²

Here,

a = side of the triangle

**Calculation:**

√3/4 × 16² 

⇒ √3/4 × 256

⇒ 64√3 cm²

**∴ The area of the equilateral triangle is 64√3 cm².**

questions.question: In a proportion, the 1st, 2ⁿd and 4th terms are 51, 68 and 108, respectively. What is the 3rd term?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The given terms are in proportion, meaning the ratio of the first two terms equals the ratio of the last two terms.

Ratio of 1st to 2ⁿd term = 51 / 68 = 3 / 4

Therefore, the ratio of the 3rd term to the 4th term must also be 3 / 4.

3rd term = 108 × 3 / 4 = 81

**∴ The correct answer is 81.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

1st term = 51

2ⁿd term = 68

4th term = 108

**Formula Used:**

If a, b, c, d are in proportion, then a : b :: c : d ⇒ a × d = b × c (Product of extremes = Product of means)

 Proportion: a : b :: c : d
 
 
 51

 Product of Extremes (51 × 108)
 
 68 × x = 51 × 108

**Calculations:**

Let the 3rd term be x.

⇒ 51 : 68 :: x : 108

⇒ 51 ÷ 68 = x ÷ 108

⇒ 68 × x = 51 × 108

⇒ x = (51 × 108) ÷ 68

⇒ x = (3 × 108) ÷ 4

⇒ x = 3 × 27

⇒ x = 81

**∴ The correct answer is 81.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Proportion

When two ratios are strictly equal, they form a proportion. It is represented as a : b :: c : d, where the Product of Means (b × c) equals the Product of Extremes (a × d).

Fourth Proportional

If a : b :: c : d, then 'd' is known as the fourth proportional to a, b, and c. It is easily found using the formula d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Mean Proportional

If three specific quantities are in continued proportion (a : b :: b : c), then 'b' is the mean proportional between 'a' and 'c'. Its value is calculated as b = √(a × c).

questions.question: Find the value of secθ - tanθ, if secθ + tanθ = sqrt5.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

secθ + tanθ = sqrt5

**Concept used:**

sec2θ - tan2θ = 1

**Calculation:**

sec²θ - tan²θ = 1

⇒ (secθ + tanθ)(secθ - tanθ) = 1

⇒ sqrt5.(secθ - tanθ) = 1

⇒ secθ - tanθ = (1)/(sqrt5)

⇒ secθ - tanθ = (sqrt5)/(sqrt5timessqrt5)

⇒ secθ - tanθ = (sqrt5)/(5)

**∴ The required answer is (sqrt5)/(5).**

questions.question: A person deposited ₹15,600 in a fixed deposit at 10% per annum simple interest. After every second year he adds his interest earned to the principal. The interest at the end of 4 years is:
questions.solution:

A person deposited ₹15,600 in a fixed deposit at 10% per annum simple interest.

**Concept used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

Here,

P = Principal

T = Time

R = Rate 

**Calculation:**

Interest after 2 years = (15600 × 10 × 2)/100

⇒ 3120

New principal after 2 years = 15600 + 3120

⇒ 18720

Now,

Interest after next 2 years = (18720 × 10 × 2)/100

⇒ 3744

Now,

Total interest after 4 years = 3120 + 3744

⇒ 6864

**∴ The required answer is 6864.**

questions.question: Ram starts from point A at 8 a.m. and reaches point B at 2 p.m. on the same day. On the same day, Raju starts from point B at 8 a.m. and reaches point A at 6 p.m. on the same day. Both points A and B are separated by only a straight line track. At what time they both meet?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ram starts from point A at 8 a.m. and reaches point B at 2 p.m. on the same day.

Raju starts from point B at 8 a.m. and reaches point A at 6 p.m.

Concept used:

Speed = Distance/Time

When two bodies move in the opposite direction then the Relative Speed = Sum of Speeds

**Calculation:**

Let the distance be D

So, speed of Ram = D/6 and speed of Raju = D/10

Now,

Relative speed = D/6 + D/10

⇒ (5D + 3D)/30

⇒ (8D)/30

Required time = (D)/(frac{8D){30}}

⇒ (30D)/(8D)

⇒ (30)/(8) hours or 225 minutes [As 1 hour = 60 min]

So, they will meet at 8 + 225 min

⇒ 8 + 3 hours and 45 min

⇒ 11:45 a.m.

**∴ The required answer is 11:45 a.m.**

questions.question: A is 40% more efficient than B. How much time will both, working together, take to finish the work, which B alone can finish in 36 days?
questions.solution:
Given:

A is 40% more efficient than B

B can complete the task in 36 days.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency of the worker × time taken by the worker

Calculation:

Let the efficiency of B be 10a

So, efficiency of A = 10a × 140%

⇒ 14a

So, total work = 10a × 36

⇒ 360a

Now,

If they both work then time = 360a/(14a + 10a)

⇒ 360a/24a

⇒ 360/24

⇒ 15

∴ The required answer is 15 days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

A is 40% more efficient than B, then the efficiency of A : B = 140 : 100 = 7 : 5

B alone can finish in 36 days, then total work = (5 × 36) = 180 unit

If A & B both working together, time taken = 180/(7 + 5) = 180/12 = 15 days

**Formula used:**

Area of a floor = a²

The diagonal of a floor = a√3

**Calculation:**

a² = 64

⇒ a = 8 m

The length of the longest rod = Diagonal of the cubical room = a√3

The length of the longest rod = 8 × √3 

⇒ 8√3 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 8sqrt3 m.**
